# Vendored Blume spike build

`blume-1.5.3.tgz` is a temporary package built from commit `7c861af` in
[Blume PR #215](https://github.com/haydenbleasel/blume/pull/215). It carries the
explicit heading-ID and raw HTML anchor support required to render the canonical
PDPP specifications without rewriting them.

SHA-256:

```text
2f53168619f370ea135bff5147c22754ec11d787bec742ae56a10c36dd8f2400  blume-1.5.3.tgz
```

Replace the tarball dependency with a released Blume version when the upstream
change is available.
